pr_title: Fix data source option for Prometheus web API in exporting configuration
pr_body:
##### Summary
Fixes #10392

##### Component Name
Exporting engine

##### Test Plan
Set `data source = raw` in the `[prometheus:exporter]` section of `exporting.conf`. Check the output of `http://localhost:19999/api/v1/allmetrics?format=prometheus` - it should not append `_average` to all metrics.

issue_context.title: Setting 'data source' in exporting.conf for prometheus doesn't seem to be honored
issue_context.body:
##### Bug report summary
We're attempting to set 'data source = as collected` in our `[prometheus:exporter]` but the value doesn't seem to be honored.

##### OS / Environment
```
CentOS Linux release 7.8.2003
```

##### Netdata version
```
netdata v1.26.0
```

##### Component Name
Prometheus in exporting.conf

##### Steps To Reproduce
1 Configure `exporting.conf` like:
```
[prometheus:exporter]
    data source = as collected
    send names instead of ids = yes
    send configured labels = yes
    send automatic labels = no
    send charts matching = *
    send hosts matching = localhost *
    prefix = netdata
```
2 Restart netdata.
3 Navigate to prometheus metrics on the host.
```
http://10.20.6.23:19999/api/v1/allmetrics?format=prometheus
```

##### Expected behavior
The prometheus metrics should have a similar output as if I appended a `source` parameter to the URL.  
```
http://10.20.6.23:19999/api/v1/allmetrics?format=prometheus&source=as-collected
```
But the metrics still have an appended `__average` name.
